mechanism: The vendor .ve flow accepts any SYSCLK/HSE it can solve (no per-ratio vendor table); agamemnon's pll_emit.py already ports the same closed-form divider search (check_pll/get_pll_vco/get_pll_div, byte-exact-validated on a 53-point vendor sweep) but previously gated emission on an enumerated SUPPORTED_RATIOS table instead of the mechanism's own legal envelope. pll_emit.evaluate_general_ratio (2026-09-25) admits any HSE=8 SYSCLK whose check_pll() solution has VCO<600 MHz (POST_DIV=1, the only regime the recovered bit map covers), and whose CLKIN_DIV/CLKFB_DIV/CLKOUT0_DIV each fall in [2, 2**(bits+1)] for their mapped field width (CLKIN 2b->[2,8], CLKOUT0 6b->[2,128], CLKFB 7b->[2,256]) -- derivation and formulas in AG32-Docs tools/vendor_parity/PLL_RATIO_MODEL_20260925.md.
evidence_for_generalization: 20/8, 40/8, 62/8 -- none in the pre-existing 43-point HSE=8 SUPPORTED_RATIOS table -- were built through the vendor af.exe .ve flow and PASSED on the board at the predicted LED rate (AG32-Docs tools/vendor_witness/CLOCK_MODE_MATRIX_20260925.md: clk_pllr_20 2442/2442/2441 vs 2441.4, clk_pllr_40 4883/4883/4883 vs 4882.8, clk_pllr_62 7568/7569/7568 vs 7568.4, all tol 5%). Combined with the pre-existing 43-point HSE=8 silicon sweep (qualification/pll_freq_evidence.jsonl, 2026-08-12, 4-248 MHz, worst 0.058% off), this is 46 independent HSE=8 points spanning the reachable range, all agreeing with the SAME closed-form divider math -- evidence the mechanism generalizes, not just the enumerated points.
open_flow_proof: AGaMEMnon build --freq 62 (previously refused: "unsupported PLL ratio SYSCLK/HSE=62/8 MHz") now emits via evaluate_general_ratio and was boarded through the open flow together with two more ratios outside the old table (33/8, 77/8); see the trailing verdict lines in this file for the exact board results, and tools/pipwit/scratch/board_queue/done/82*_pll_*.json in AG32-Docs for the raw job/result pairs.
byte_exact_regression: The general model must never reject anything the old table admitted: pll_emit.py's require_supported_ratio checks the enumerated SUPPORTED_RATIOS table FIRST (unchanged, still the sole path for HSE!=8), and test_pll_emit.py::test_general_ratio_model_covers_every_hse8_table_entry_too asserts evaluate_general_ratio solves every HSE=8 table entry. tests/test_pll_emit.py::test_closed_form_reproduces_every_vendor_sweep_divider_encoding still reproduces all 53 vendor sweep points byte-exact, unmodified.
kill_switch: AGAMEMNON_NO_PLL_RATIO_MODEL (any non-empty value) reverts HSE=8 admission to the enumerated SUPPORTED_RATIOS table only, reproducing pre-2026-09-25 behavior exactly; it can only narrow, never widen, what a release-strict build emits (agamemnon/engine/claim_policy.py exemption, same class as AGAMEMNON_NO_FFBRIDGE/AGAMEMNON_NO_OMUX_PRESENT0/AGAMEMNON_NO_BRAM_NARROW_WRITE).
scope: Qualifies the GENERAL HSE=8 PLL ratio admission mechanism (not a fixed enumerated point set): any SYSCLK whose dividers fall inside the recovered legal PFD/VCO/bit-width envelope. Does not extend to any other HSE reference, to PLL outputs other than CLKOUT0, or to phase/duty/feedback/bypass modes -- those stay enumerated-only or unqualified per docs/HAL_FPGA_REFERENCE.md.

method: AGaMEMnon open-flow builds (branch work/pll-ratios-20260925, uarch nextpnr <AGAMEMNON_UARCH_NEXTPNR>, unmodified) of designs_open/clk_pllr_{33,62,77}.v (AG32-Docs tools/vendor_witness/designs_open/, identical body to clk_pllr_20/40.v -- a plain hb[12] heartbeat counter clocked by `clock`) via `python3 -m agamemnon.cli build clk_pllr_<rate>.v --uarch --seed 1 --pcf clock.pcf --freq <rate> -o clk_pllr_<rate>.bin`, all three exit 0 with zero fatals; emitted preamble bytes 144-150 match pll_emit.emit_fields(<rate>,8) exactly. Boarded via the queue only (AG32-Docs tools/pipwit/scratch/board_queue/pending/82{0,1,2}_pll_{62,33,77}.json, drained by the running board owner, never invoked directly), one control (blinky, PASS) plus one design job each, board_corpus.py --led-gp 7 --reset-gp 2 --cycles-per-edge 8192 --freq-mhz <rate>.
note: 62/8 closes the exact gap reported (previously refused `unsupported PLL ratio SYSCLK/HSE=62/8 MHz`); 33/8 and 77/8 are two more points never in any enumerated table (75/8, the task's original suggestion, was found already silicon-qualified in SILICON_QUALIFIED_HSE8 and so was swapped for 77 to test genuinely new territory). All three within ~0.02% of predicted, well inside the 5% harness tolerance, with static controls before/after.
scope: Qualifies the AGaMEMnon OPEN-FLOW build+silicon path specifically for these three ratios (33/8, 62/8, 77/8), on top of the general validity-model admission qualified above.
